SELECT
    O.POHNUM_0,
    O.BPSNUM_0,
    SUP.BPSNAM_0,
    O.QTYPUU_0 as quantite_total,
    O.RCPQTYPUU_0 as quantite_receptionne,
    A.ITMREF_0,
    A.ITMDES1_0,
    O.XMARQ_0,
  O.ORDDAT_0,
  '{{ $json.numero_facture }}' as numero_facture,
  '{{ $json.designation }}' as designation_article,
  {{ $json.montant_ht_num }} as montant_ht,
  {{ $json.montant_ttc_num }} as montant_ttc,
  '{{ $json.date }}' as date_facture
FROM BASE1.PORDERQ O
INNER JOIN BASE1.ITMMASTER A ON O.ITMREF_0 = A.ITMREF_0
  INNER JOIN BASE1.BPSUPPLIER SUP ON SUP.BPSNUM_0=O.BPSNUM_0
WHERE O.POHNUM_0 = 'BC167990'
  AND O.ITMREF_0 = 'A13302'
GROUP BY
    O.POHNUM_0,
    O.BPSNUM_0,
      O.XMARQ_0,
  O.ORDDAT_0,
    SUP.BPSNAM_0,
    A.ITMREF_0,
